overview: This enum selects the result bonuses that the game evaluates after a battle, such as winning, dealing damage, and finishing quickly.

None.simple: No result bonus is recorded for this entry.
None.technical: FGameDataTableRow_ResultScore defaults ResultScore to None. The evaluator has no None case, so a row with this value reaches the default branch and adds no bonus. The result UI maps Type 0 to NAME_None.

Win.simple: The fighter wins with some stock already spent.
Win.technical: A bonus is added when the character team equals the winner team and that team stock is below its maximum stock.

OverwhelmingWin.simple: The fighter wins with full stock.
OverwhelmingWin.technical: A bonus is added when the character team is the winner, the time limit is infinite or remaining time is above zero, and that team stock is at its maximum.

GoodFight.simple: A losing fighter earns this when the rival is nearly out of stock.
GoodFight.technical: A bonus is added for a character whose team is not the winner when the rival stock is finite and rival stock is at most rival maximum stock multiplied by the mode threshold.

Defeat.simple: This tracks defeats recorded for a fighter.
Defeat.technical: Uses Scaled on the sent Dead total. The total is truncated to int32, capped by UpperLimit when UpperLimit is positive, and multiplied by the row Score.

Assist.simple: This rewards assists recorded for a fighter.
Assist.technical: Uses Scaled on the sent Attack_Assist total. The total is truncated to int32, capped by UpperLimit when UpperLimit is positive, and multiplied by the row Score.

Damage.simple: This rewards damage dealt to opponents.
Damage.technical: A bonus is added when the sent Attack_Damage total is above zero. The evaluator overwrites Entry.Value with the total cast to int32.

LevelUp.simple: This rewards Cursed Energy level ups.
LevelUp.technical: Uses Scaled on the sent CursedEnergy_LevelUp total. The count is capped by UpperLimit when positive and multiplied by the row Score.

MaximumOutput.simple: This rewards reaching a high Cursed Energy level.
MaximumOutput.technical: A bonus is added when the sent CursedEnergy_Level total is above 3.0f. The evaluator uses this fixed comparison for the bonus.

LinkCombo.simple: This rewards hits in a link combo.
LinkCombo.technical: Uses Scaled on the sent LinkCombo_Hit total. The count is capped by UpperLimit when positive and multiplied by the row Score.

SpecialTagCombo.technical: Uses Scaled on the sent SpecialTagCombo_Count total. The count is capped by UpperLimit when positive and multiplied by the row Score.

SuperCursedEnergyAttack.simple: This rewards landing a Super Cursed Energy Attack.
SuperCursedEnergyAttack.technical: A bonus is added when the sent SuperCursedEnergyAttack_Hit total is above zero. The result UI gives Type 11 a character-specific label and falls back to the shared label for that type.

SpecialAttackFinish.simple: This rewards finishing a battle with a special attack.
SpecialAttackFinish.technical: A bonus is added when the character team is the winner and the battle finish-kind byte StudioByte_A3A is not 0xFF.

FirstAttack.technical: A bonus is added when GetFirstAttackCharacter returns this character.

FirstKill.simple: This rewards scoring the first knockout.
FirstKill.technical: A bonus is added when GetFirstKillCharacter returns this character.

NoGuard.simple: This rewards a fighter who was never made to guard.
NoGuard.technical: Uses NoneReceived on the received Guard total. A bonus is added when the total exists and is at most zero.

NoDeath.simple: This rewards a fighter who was never defeated.
NoDeath.technical: Uses NoneReceived on the received Dead total. A bonus is added when the total exists and is at most zero.

NoDamage.simple: This rewards a fighter who took no damage.
NoDamage.technical: Uses NoneReceived on the received Attack_Damage total. A bonus is added when the total exists and is at most zero.

FastFinish.technical: A bonus is added when the character team is the winner and the sent TimeLimit total is at most the mode threshold. The TimeLimit log value stores battle time accumulated from DeltaTime.

GuardBreak.simple: This rewards breaking an opponent guard.
GuardBreak.technical: A bonus is added when the sent GuardBreak total is above zero, using the unchanged row Score.

Finisher.simple: This rewards being the fighter shown as the battle finisher.
Finisher.technical: A bonus is added when FocusActor848 is this character. EvaluateRankingRecords also checks this bonus to award the Finisher ranking record.

Debuff.technical: Uses Scaled on the sent Debuff total. The count is capped by UpperLimit when positive and multiplied by the row Score.

LongShot.simple: This rewards landing attacks from far away.
LongShot.technical: Uses AtLeastThreshold on the sent AttackHitRange total. A bonus is added when that total is at least the mode threshold.

KillStreak.simple: This rewards closely spaced battle-log totals.
KillStreak.technical: The evaluator reads the character total log values and adds a bonus when any adjacent pair differs by at most the mode threshold.

Involvement.simple: This rewards frequent involvement in attacks.
Involvement.technical: A bonus is added when the round log block AttackTarget.ValueA4 is at most the mode threshold. A missing round block returns FLT_MAX. ValueA4 holds the smallest banked attack-target timer.

JustGuard.technical: Uses Scaled on the received JustGuard total. The count is capped by UpperLimit when positive and multiplied by the row Score.

Runner.simple: This rewards the fighter who moved the farthest.
Runner.technical: A bonus is initially added when the sent MovedDistance total is above zero. After all characters are evaluated, the bonus is removed from every character except the one with the greatest positive total. MovedDistance accumulates metres from ModeTravel2D multiplied by 0.01.

WallBound.simple: This rewards slamming an opponent into a wall.
WallBound.technical: A bonus is added when the sent WallBound total is above zero, using the unchanged row Score.

GroundBound.simple: This rewards slamming an opponent into the ground.
GroundBound.technical: A bonus is added when the sent GroundBound total is above zero, using the unchanged row Score.

ReturnToHell.technical: Uses AtLeastThreshold on the sent Revival total. A bonus is added when that total is at least the mode threshold.

DomainExpansionReturn.simple: This rewards returning from a Domain Expansion.
DomainExpansionReturn.technical: A bonus is added when the sent DomainExpansion_Return total is above zero, using the unchanged row Score.

Provocation.technical: A bonus is added when the sent Provocation total is above zero, using the unchanged row Score.

DomainExpansionOverlap.technical: A bonus is added when the sent DomainExpansion_Overlap total is above zero, using the unchanged row Score.

Respect.simple: This rewards earning respect in battle.
Respect.technical: A bonus is added when the sent Respect total is above zero, using the unchanged row Score.

NoOperation.simple: This rewards long stretches without operation.
NoOperation.technical: Uses AtLeastThreshold on the sent NoOperationTotal total. A bonus is added when that total is at least the mode threshold.

Invalid.simple: This value is a reserved invalid marker.
Invalid.technical: Declared as the uint8 slot 255 in the enum header. The evaluator has no Invalid case, so a row with this value reaches the default branch and adds no bonus. The result UI maps Type 255 to NAME_None.

notes: EvaluateResultBonuses copies ResultScore into FStudioBattleBonusEntry.Type and stores the row Score in Value. Scaled truncates a positive total to int32, applies UpperLimit when that limit is positive, and multiplies by Score. Positive, NoneReceived, and AtLeastThreshold add the unchanged Score.
The result UI uses Type as a key in GBattleResultLabel11Map. Type 11 switches to a character-specific label map with the shared label as fallback. Types 0 and 255 resolve to NAME_None.
Runner entries are removed from every character except the farthest positive-distance mover after all characters are evaluated.
The mode threshold comes from Threshold_Story, Threshold_PvE_Normal, Threshold_PvE_Survival, or Threshold_Arcade according to BattleMode and MissionKind.
